questions: Are you currently experiencing a sudden or rapidly worsening health problem?
Are you having trouble breathing or feeling unable to get enough air?
Are you having chest pain, pressure, or tightness?
Have you fainted, nearly fainted, or become unusually difficult to wake?
Have you developed sudden weakness, numbness, facial drooping, trouble speaking, confusion, or loss of vision?
Are you having severe pain anywhere in your body?
Are you bleeding heavily or vomiting blood?
Have you had a serious injury recently?
Do you have a fever or unusually low body temperature?
Are you experiencing repeated vomiting or unable to keep fluids down?
Do you have severe abdominal pain?
Do you have a new severe headache or neck stiffness?
Are you having a new rash, swelling of the face or throat, or difficulty swallowing?
Are you pregnant or could you be pregnant?
Have you noticed a new lump, swelling, or change in the appearance of any body part?
Have you had a persistent cough, pain, or other symptom for more than two weeks?
Have you experienced an unexplained change in weight, appetite, or energy?
Have you had thoughts of harming yourself or someone else?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed any medication, supplement, or recreational drug?
Do you have any diagnosed medical conditions?
